title: SuperAmazingArmor
description: This Mod Adds Armor Tools, Building Blocks, and More.
body:
🧱 Overview

This mod expands Minecraft with a variety of new armor, tools, items, and blocks, designed to enhance both survival and creative gameplay.

It focuses on adding meaningful content that fits naturally into the vanilla experience while giving players more progression options and building variety.

✨ Features
Armor Sets
New armor with improved stats and unique designs
Tools
Faster and more durable tools for efficient gameplay
Items
Useful and interesting additions to support exploration and crafting
Blocks
New building and decorative blocks to expand creativity
⚙️ Requirements
Minecraft: 1.20.1
Loader: Forge
Forge Version: 47.2.0
📦 Installation
Install Forge 47.2.0 for Minecraft 1.20.1
Download the mod .jar file
Place it in your mods folder
Launch the game with Forge
